semiconductor_relevance: High — Kurosaka Plating specializes in advanced surface technologies critical for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and components.
summary: Kurosaka Plating Industry Co., Ltd. manufactures high-performance surface technologies, particularly focusing on electroless nickel anodizing. Their technologies are essential for precision parts used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including cooling structures and vacuum equipment.
capabilities: Electroless nickel anodizing for precision parts
Application of Ag films for inter-wafer bonding
Surface treatments for vacuum pump equipment
Cooling plate manufacturing for semiconductor applications
